clips.title: The story
paras: Along Blackfathom Deeps, the naga are harvesting the glowing Sapphires of Aku'Mai. Water spirits cling to the crystals, and Je'neu Sancrea seeks help confiscating them before their arcane power can be exploited.

Blackfathom Deeps holds Sapphires of Aku'Mai in its watery cavern entrances along Ashenvale's Zoram Strand. Water spirits cling to the crystalline formations, rich in elemental energy, making them potent aids in magical workings. When scouts reported the subterranean naga quarrying the gems from cavern walls, Je'neu Sancrea, a shaman, sought adventuring help to confiscate them. In naga hands, the stones could fuel devastating arcane rites.
